ValidationRule.description: Prevents any further edits to the Lead record once it has reached "Converted" or "Closed Lost".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Converted"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Closed Lost") ), NOT(ISNEW()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This record is locked. Leads in "Converted" or "Closed Lost" status cannot be edited.
